run_write_policy_tf_examples: run the script to convert miniwob episode protos to tf examples with input and output flags
build_convert_episode_to_tf_examples: build a function that converts an episode of steps into tf.train.Example records with image, parse, and id features
run_convert_episode_beam: run the ConvertEpisode beam DoFn to filter episodes by reward threshold and convert them to tf examples
build_pipeline: build an apache beam pipeline that reads episode protos, converts them to tf examples, and writes them to output directory
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with argv to execute the beam pipeline for converting demonstrations to training data
